cards.back: Mixed media textiles break boundaries by incorporating non-traditional materials: paper, wire, plastic, found objects.

cards.front: What should you know about textile design exam tips?
cards.back: Show CLOSE-UP photographs of surface detail. Annotate each material and technique with its purpose. Test MATERIAL COMPATIBILITY — do materials work together structurally? Link to artists who use mixed media textiles.

Students often make mistakes with this topic. Wrong: Mixed media textiles are just about sticking random materials onto fabric. Correct: Mixed media textiles require the same INTENTIONALITY as any art form — every material choice should serve a purpose.
